nina (People Ops): Heads-up: Miguel asked to rebook his approved PTO from Dec 27-31 to Jan 3-5 because his flight was canceled. The original dates are during our year-end shutdown window (Dec 26-31) and payroll cutoff is Jan 1 for holiday payouts. Can managers approve moving PTO into the next week? Any payroll implications?

sam (Eng Lead): If it's during the company shutdown that's usually fine, but moving into Jan might conflict with the first sprint planning week. Who's covering Miguel's mobile test signoff?

harper (QA): Miguel is the owner for the mobile regression signoff scheduled Jan 4. If he moves PTO to Jan 3-5, we need a backup to run signoff or shift the date.

miguel (mobile): I can keep the Dec 27-29 days and move Dec 30-31 to Jan 3-4 instead of the whole block, so I still do the Jan 4 signoff morning remote if needed. My travel is fully rebooked for Jan 3 return.

nina (People Ops): Process reminder: managers can approve intra-year swaps that cross calendar boundaries as long as the employee confirms in writing, team coverage >= 60% on affected working days, and payroll is notified if the change affects cutoff/payouts. If PTO moves into the next fiscal period and the employee requests carryover or payout, that's a separate payroll workflow.

paul (HR): Payroll note: Year-end shutdown days are paid as regular PTO if booked. Moving days into the next calendar year does not automatically change carryover status. If Miguel wants to convert unused shutdown days to payout, that must be submitted before the payroll cutoff (Dec 31 23:59 UTC). Since he's moving days into Jan, no payout is triggered. If anyone else has days falling into a new accrual period, contact payroll with the employee ID and requested action.

sam (Eng Lead): Proposed plan:
```
Dec 27-29: miguel off (keep as-is)
Dec 30-31: convert to Jan 3-4 PTO
Jan 4 morning: miguel remote 08:30-09:30 for mobile regression signoff; harper as backup for full run
```
I'll post this coverage plan to #eng-mobile and tag @nina. Managers, please reply `approved` here for audit.

ops-bot: Reminder — payroll cutoff for year-end payout processing: 1672531199 (Dec 31 23:59 UTC).

harper (QA): I can run the full signoff on Jan 4 if remote attendance fails. Please add the runbook link to the handoff doc.

miguel (mobile): Confirmed — I'll update calendar and the handoff doc and be remote Jan 4 morning. Thanks.

nina (People Ops): Noted. Once the coverage post is up and a manager replies `approved` here, I'll record the swap in our PTO ledger. If Miguel later asks for payout for any shutdown days, remind him to file before cutoff. Closing after the #eng-mobile post.

sam (Eng Lead): approved
